findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration or Terraform state. These credentials are also visible in source control.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) to encrypt environment variables at rest, and sensitive secrets are stored in plain text within the environment block, increasing risk of credential exposure.
